name: Mahou Shou x Monogatari
source:
Our story begins with an encounter:
a creature bestows magic that makes the "impossible" possible.

Mine D. Raul is a "keiyakuju", a beast that makes contracts with humans.
In doing so it gives the contractee unlimited magical freedom.

The power to make the impossible possible.
That's true magic.
If you wielded it... what would you do?

Young boys with good intentions make their contracts.
To bring humanity together.
To defeat evil.
Compassionate shonens.

But compassion, virtue, dreams, hopes...
They are all corruptible.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ192245.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我们的故事从一次邂逅开始：
一种生物赋予魔法，使“不可能”成为可能。

我的D·劳尔是与人类签订契约的野兽“keiyakuju”。
这样做就赋予了契约者无限的魔法自由。

使不可能成为可能的力量。
这才是真正的魔法。
如果你拥有它……你会做什么？

怀着善意的小男孩签订了合同。
让人类团结在一起。
去战胜邪恶。
富有同情心的少年。

但慈悲、美德、梦想、希望……
它们都是易腐烂的。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ192245.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
